messages:
maria: Quick bug report: async Python SDK drops validation details when raising ApiError for 422. Only status_code + text remain.

kevin: Which transport? httpx AsyncClient?

maria: Yes. Our wrapper reads stream then closes response; ApiError.from_response doesn't preserve body. Repro: await resp.json() has errors but exception has none.

sam: We should store raw_body (capped, e.g. 64KB) and parsed json_body if valid. Also capture x-request-id header into request_id on the exception for tracing.

kevin: Agreed. Add ApiError.normalized_errors property that lazily extracts strings from problem+json arrays to make UI handling easier.

maria: I'll prepare a small PR: read await response.aread() for async, response.content for sync, try json.loads, set truncated flag if too long, update types.pyi. Tests: async and sync 422 preserve json_body and truncated behavior.

bot-ci: Created issue #4722: "python sdk: preserve body & json in ApiError (async) + request_id + truncation" and added failing test.

kevin: Note: ensure retry middleware doesn't retry 4xx. Also include changelog/migration note.

maria: On it, assigning myself. Will ping for reviews.
